experiment: SQL page/count snapshot consistency under a concurrent writer

protocol.semantic_sql: SELECT id FROM items WHERE q = 1 ORDER BY id
protocol.page_sql: SELECT s.id, m.gen, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n_stmt FROM (SELECT id FROM items WHERE q = 1) s CROSS JOIN meta m ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 100

variants.unsafe: page and count as two autocommit statements

pass_criterion: every consistent block has 0 inconsistent pairs and 0 wrong certificates
